disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 核查了凭据处理路径：host 端经宿主凭据服务读取 DeepSeek API Key、平台 Token、OpenCode Go Key 三个密钥，均只在宿主进程内用于对官方接口的 HTTP 请求，浏览器端代码与 README 均未接触密钥原文。未发现硬编码密钥、密钥批量枚举或钱包相关代码。
checked_items.en: Audited credential handling path: The host side reads three secrets (DeepSeek API Key, platform Token, OpenCode Go Key) via the host credential service, all used only within the host process for HTTP requests to official interfaces. The browser-side code and README do not expose the raw key values. No hardcoded credentials, batch key enumeration, or wallet-related code found.

checked_items.zh: 核查了敏感文件读取面：未发现读取 .credentials.yaml、~/.ssh、云凭据等敏感路径的代码路径。
checked_items.en: Audited sensitive file read surface: No code paths found that read sensitive paths such as .credentials.yaml, ~/.ssh, or cloud credentials.

evidence.zh: 未发现凭据外泄链：凭据仅在宿主进程内随 HTTP 请求发送至三个官方接口（api.deepseek.com、platform.deepseek.com、opencode.ai），浏览器只经本插件本地路由取展示数据，不出本地。所有外联端点与 README 声明一致。
evidence.en: No credential exfiltration chain found: Credentials are only sent within the host process via HTTP requests to three official endpoints (api.deepseek.com, platform.deepseek.com, opencode.ai). The browser only fetches display data through a local route provided by this plugin, with no outbound traffic. All outbound endpoints are consistent with the README declaration.

checked_items.zh: 核查了模型可读文本面：本插件未注册任何 LLM 工具、未向系统提示词注入段落，树内不存在 SKILL.md/AGENTS.md 等模型面指令文件，README 与代码注释无可疑指令措辞或诱导性文本。
checked_items.en: Audited model-readable text surface: This plugin does not register any LLM tools, does not inject paragraphs into the system prompt, and no model-oriented instruction files such as SKILL.md/AGENTS.md exist within the repository. The README and code comments contain no suspicious instruction phrasing or manipulative text.

checked_items.zh: 核查了运行时消息注入与上下文篡改面：未发现监听 agent/pre-step 改写模型输入、未发现压缩引擎实现（CompactionEngine）、未发现附件存储实现。
checked_items.en: Audited runtime message injection and context tampering surface: No listeners for agent/pre-step to modify model input, no CompactionEngine implementation, and no attachment storage implementation found.

evidence.zh: 插件不注册 LLM 工具、不注入系统提示词段落，无工具描述可供投毒，场景不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin does not register LLM tools or inject system prompt paragraphs. There is no tool description available for poisoning, so the scenario is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 无工具描述、无诱导安装或改写配置的措辞，注入驱动安装场景不适用。
evidence.en: No tool descriptions, no wording that induces installation or configuration rewriting. The injection-driven installation scenario is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 未监听 agent/pre-step 事件，无模型输入改写面，场景不适用。
evidence.en: No listener for agent/pre-step event, no model input rewriting surface, scenario not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 核查了动态代码执行面：host 端引用了系统子进程模块（lib/index.js 第 46 行，import { execFile }），但仅用于以参数数组方式调用内置的 Python 提取脚本（不经 shell 解释、无字符串拼接成命令）；bundle 内无 eval / new Function 调用、无 cordis_define / cordis_run 动态包调用。
checked_items.en: Audited dynamic code execution surface: The host side imports the system subprocess module (lib/index.js line 46, import { execFile }), but it is only used to invoke the built-in Python extraction script with an argument array (no shell interpretation, no string concatenation to form commands). No eval/new Function calls, no cordis_define/cordis_run dynamic package invocations found within the bundle.

checked_items.zh: 静态预扫命中清单逐条裁决：规则 DSH-X05 / DG-R3-57 两处（lib/client.js 第 1901、2220 行）均为按 Esc 关闭下拉面板的界面行为，无按键记录、剪贴板或凭据访问；规则 DSH-X03 / DG-R3-55（lib/index.js 第 46 行）仅用于运行固定的内置 Python 提取脚本，无任意命令执行——三条命中全部判定为良性，不生成发现。
checked_items.en: Static pre-scan hits adjudicated item by item: Rule DSH-X05 / DG-R3-57 (two locations in lib/client.js lines 1901 and 2220) are both UI behaviors for closing a dropdown panel by pressing Esc, with no key logging, clipboard access, or credential access. Rule DSH-X03 / DG-R3-55 (lib/index.js line 46) is only used to run a fixed built-in Python extraction script, with no arbitrary command execution. All three hits are judged benign, no findings generated.

checked_items.zh: 核查了安装与执行载体：package.json 无 preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare 安装钩子，树内无 .husky、GitHub Actions、devcontainer、Makefile、.gitmodules 等执行载体；client bundle 无混淆或动态解码执行。
checked_items.en: Audited installation and execution carriers: package.json has no preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare install hooks. No .husky, GitHub Actions, devcontainer, Makefile, .gitmodules, or other execution carriers in the repository. The client bundle has no obfuscation or dynamic decode execution.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置（cordis.patch.yml）仅插入一行插件注册，无 !!js 动态标量，不存在配置求值执行面。
evidence.en: The patch configuration (cordis.patch.yml) only inserts one line for plugin registration, with no !!js dynamic scalar. There is no configuration evaluation execution surface.

evidence.zh: 未发现对 cordis_define / cordis_run 动态包工具的调用，self-modification 场景不适用。
evidence.en: No calls to cordis_define/cordis_run dynamic package tools found. The self-modification scenario is not applicable.

evidence.zh: package.json 无任何安装钩子，树内无 git 钩子、无 CI/CD 工作流、无 devcontainer 配置等执行载体。
evidence.en: package.json has no install hooks. No git hooks, CI/CD workflows, devcontainer configuration, or other execution carriers exist in the repository.

evidence.zh: 已声明浏览器 bundle（dsh.client）；专项扫描确认其只做壁纸/余额/用量界面与 5 条本地路由请求，键盘监听仅为关闭下拉面板，未访问剪贴板或特权接口。
evidence.en: The browser bundle (dsh.client) is declared. A dedicated scan confirmed it only handles the wallpaper/balance/usage UI and 5 local route requests. Keyboard listening is only for closing the dropdown panel, with no clipboard or privileged interface access.

evidence.zh: 未调用注册外部子代理提供方，无进程外委派面，场景不适用。
evidence.en: No registration of external sub-agent providers, no out-of-process delegation surface, scenario not applicable.

evidence.zh: 未发现后台任务（jobs.start）、定时任务（schedule_create）、持久目标（create_goal）注册，未监听轮次终止事件（agent/turn-stopping），dsh 原生持驻场景不适用。
evidence.en: No background tasks (jobs.start), scheduled tasks (schedule_create), or persistent goals (create_goal) registered. No listener for round-termination event (agent/turn-stopping). The dsh native persistent scenario is not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 核查了外联面：host 端仅向三个官方接口发 HTTP 请求（DeepSeek 余额 api.deepseek.com、DeepSeek 平台用量 platform.deepseek.com、OpenCode Go 用量 opencode.ai），均与 README 声明功能一致；浏览器端只请求本插件注册的 5 条本地路由，无直接外联。
checked_items.en: Audited outbound connection surface: The host side only sends HTTP requests to three official endpoints (DeepSeek balance api.deepseek.com, DeepSeek platform usage platform.deepseek.com, OpenCode Go usage opencode.ai), all consistent with the declared functionality in the README. The browser side only requests 5 local routes registered by this plugin, with no direct outbound connections.

checked_items.zh: 核查了数据外发通道：未发现编码后外发、DNS 隧道、webhook、粘贴服务等带外通道；未发现修改 AI 端点环境变量或代理指向非官方地址的代码。
checked_items.en: Audited data exfiltration channels: No encoded exfiltration, DNS tunneling, webhooks, paste services, or other out-of-band channels found. No code found that modifies AI endpoint environment variables or proxies pointing to non-official addresses.

evidence.zh: 未监听模型请求路由事件（agent/request、agent/request-error），未注册自定义 LLM 适配器（registerAdapter），无运行时路由劫持面，场景不适用。
evidence.en: No model request routing events (agent/request, agent/request-error) listened to, no custom LLM adapter registered (registerAdapter), no runtime routing hijack surface, scenario not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 核查了供应链依赖面：插件无任何第三方运行时依赖（只使用 Node 内置模块），无 package lock 文件，无 git 依赖浮动引用，无远程脚本拉取执行。
checked_items.en: Audited supply chain dependency surface: The plugin has no third-party runtime dependencies (only uses Node built-in modules). No package lock file, no floating git dependency references, no remote script fetch and execute.

checked_items.zh: 核查了挂载配置补丁面：cordis.patch.yml 仅插入插件注册行（id/name），未触碰沙箱/审批/权限相关配置行，无 disabled:true、无环境变量降权写法、未改写 inject/intercept 字段。
checked_items.en: Audited patch configuration surface: cordis.patch.yml only inserts a plugin registration line (id/name), does not touch sandbox, approval, or permission-related configuration lines. No disabled:true, no environment variable downgrade phrasing, no rewriting of inject/intercept fields.

checked_items.zh: 核查了审批链与身份：未用高优先级监听（prepend）截断工具执行前或审批请求等安全事件；作者与仓库来源一致，无名称仿冒信号。
checked_items.en: Audited approval chain and identity: No high-priority listener (prepend) used to intercept security events such as tool pre-execution or approval requests. The author and repository source are consistent, with no name spoofing signals.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未触碰任何安全配置行，不含降权或禁用写法，patch 覆盖安全行场景不适用。
evidence.en: The patch configuration does not touch any security configuration lines, does not contain downgrade or disable phrasing. The patch-overwriting-security-lines scenario is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 未以 prepend 方式监听 tools/pre-execute 或 approval/request 等安全事件，审批链无可截断入口。
evidence.en: No listener for tools/pre-execute or approval/request security events with prepend priority. The approval chain has no interceptable entry point.

evidence.zh: 首次审计无版本基线，无法比对升级后新增的 bundle/client/service 声明，场景不适用。
evidence.en: First audit, no version baseline. Cannot compare newly added bundle/client/service declarations after upgrade. Scenario not applicable.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写 inject/intercept 字段，无给安全插件追加必需服务致其 pending 的篡改面。
evidence.en: The patch configuration does not rewrite inject/intercept fields. No tampering surface that appends required services to security plugins, causing them to be pending.

checked_items.zh: 核查了运行时面：插件未自行启动 web 服务或监听端口，仅向宿主 web 服务注册 5 条精确路由（余额、会话费用、壁纸提取、壁纸文件、OpenCode 用量）；未做动态沙箱验证（本次审计未提供动态运行产物）。
checked_items.en: Audited runtime surface: The plugin does not start a web service or listen on ports itself. It only registers 5 precise routes (balance, session cost, wallpaper extraction, wallpaper file, OpenCode usage) on the host web service. No dynamic sandbox verification performed (no dynamic runtime artifacts provided in this audit).

evidence.zh: 插件不自行监听端口；宿主本机 WebSocket/HTTP RPC 无认证属 dsh 生态固有风险，非本插件引入，路由仅暴露余额/用量/壁纸提取等自身功能数据。
evidence.en: The plugin does not listen on ports itself. The host's local WebSocket/HTTP RPC lacks authentication, which is an inherent risk of the dsh ecosystem, not introduced by this plugin. The routes only expose its own functional data such as balance, usage, and wallpaper extraction.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核查通过：插件名称/版本/commit 与任务卡一致，bundle 声明与 client 声明匹配 package.json 结构，无名称仿冒信号。
summary.en: Metadata and identity verification passed: Plugin name/version/commit match the task card, bundle declaration and client declaration match the package.json structure, with no name spoofing signals.

summary.zh: 静态扫描共命中 3 条（键盘监听×2、子进程引用×1），逐条复核后全部判定为良性功能代码，无恶意或风险落地。
summary.en: Static scan hit 3 items (keyboard listening ×2, subprocess reference ×1). After item-by-item review, all are judged as benign functional code, with no malicious or risk-bearing content.

summary.zh: 行为分析未检出安装钩子、混淆载荷、凭据文件读取或未声明外联。
summary.en: Behavior analysis did not detect install hooks, obfuscated payloads, credential file reads, or undeclared outbound connections.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查未检出工具描述投毒、系统提示注入或模型面指令文件。
summary.en: AI metadata review did not detect tool description poisoning, system prompt injection, or model-oriented instruction files.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（未提供动态运行产物）。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification performed (no dynamic runtime artifacts provided).

limits.zh: L4 动态沙箱未启用（未提供动态运行产物），运行时行为仅静态推断；package.json 未显式声明能力矩阵，能力声明按代码实测推断；manifest 中 2.4MB 的截图 PNG 为多媒体资源，未逐字节分析；壁纸提取路由接受用户输入的绝对目录路径并运行内置 Python 脚本，属 README 声明的功能，其可达性受宿主本机 RPC 生态固有风险约束。
limits.en: L4 dynamic sandbox not enabled (no dynamic runtime artifacts provided), runtime behavior only inferred statically. package.json does not explicitly declare a capability matrix; capability declarations are inferred from code. The 2.4MB screenshot PNG in the manifest is a multimedia resource not byte-analyzed. The wallpaper extraction route accepts a user-provided absolute directory path and runs a built-in Python script, which is a declared feature in the README; its reachability is constrained by the inherent risks of the host local RPC ecosystem.
